title: Unskillful
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.146 Numbered Discourses 3.146
  • 15. Maṅgalavagga 15. Good Fortune

Akusalasutta Unskillful

“Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye. “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there. Katamehi tīhi? What three? Akusalena kāyakammena, akusalena vacīkammena, akusalena manokammena—Unskillful deeds by way of body, speech, and mind.

Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye. Someone with these three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge. Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there. Katamehi tīhi? What three? Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena—Skillful deeds by way of body, speech, and mind.

Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti. Someone with these three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
